sources.title: Cuba Travel: regulations and formalities
sources.officialityEvidence: Cuba's official Ministry of Tourism portal gives the tourist-visa route and identifies the electronic service as available worldwide except for the stated United States purchasing exception.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tourist visas via internet replace the Tourist Card and are available worldwide, except for the United States-specific purchase arrangement.

policies.title: Swiss ordinary passports: named visa-free visitor routes
policies.summary: Current destination-government material expressly establishes visa-free ordinary Swiss-passport visitor access for the listed destinations.
conditions: BA: the current Ministry of Security visitor information includes the Swiss Confederation in the visa-free nationality set. UA: up to 90 days in 180 days for private or tourist purposes; wartime border access remains separate.
This is a narrow ordinary-passport visitor baseline and does not classify work, residence, study, special documents, document validity, security restrictions, carrier conditions or final admission.

policies.title: Swiss ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's official Tourism Ministry portal identifies an internet tourist-visa process that replaces the Tourist Card and is available worldwide, including Switzerland.
conditions: The portal describes an internet tourist visa replacing the Tourist Card and states worldwide availability except for a United States-specific purchase arrangement.

Tourist visas are single-entry and normally allow up to 90 days, extendable for a further 90 days. Cuban citizens/residents, work, residence, transit, health declarations, route-specific carrier requirements and final admission are outside this classification.

application.label: Cuba electronic tourist-visa service
steps: Apply for the tourist visa online before departure using the Swiss ordinary passport to be used for travel.
Follow the official service's instructions for the visa code and any required travel declaration.
Meet all passport, insurance, return-ticket and final-admission conditions.
